name: Thornfiber Belt with Pouches
description: A sturdy belt of woven Thornfiber Cane with fitted pouches for field gear — the Feywood's standard traveling belt, widely worn by rangers, gatherers, and Vaelmere residents.
narrative_effects: Carries small gear (Silverleaf Balm, fire kit, small tools, field notes) in organized fashion.
Thornfiber weave is weather-resistant and maintains shape across long service.
